sentences.Ja, hei, dette er Malik Doran, klassekon: Yes, hi, this is Malik Doran, class parent rep in Jasmin's class.
sentences.Jeg håper at dere kan komme på foreldrem: I hope you can come to the parents' meeting on Thursday.
sentences.Ja, jeg har tenkt å komme. Mannen min sk: Yes, I'm planning to come. My husband is going to look after the children.
I have a question for you.
sentences.Den andre klassekontakten, mor til Ingri: The other class rep, Ingrid's mother, is moving, and now we need a new one.
sentences.Kan du overta, tror du?: Do you think you could take over?
I don't know what a class rep does.
sentences.Det visste ikke jeg heller da jeg begynt: I didn't know either when I started.
sentences.Men man skal være kontaktperson mellom l: But you're the contact person between the teacher and the other parents.
sentences.Vi får god informasjon om hva vi skal gj: We get good information about what we have to do.
Well, you could think about it a bit.
sentences.Jeg sender deg litt mer informasjon på e: I'll send you some more information by email. Is that OK?
Then I'll call you again tomorrow.
sentences.Ja, gjør det. Men jeg er ikke sikker på: Yes, do that. But I'm not sure if I want to. I'm very busy.
sentences.Det er en fin måte å bli kjent med skole: It's a good way to get to know the school.
sentences.Han er klassekontakt i Jasmins klasse og: He is a class rep in Jasmin's class and wants Amira to become one too.
sentences.Hun vet ikke hva en klassekontakt er, og: She doesn't know what a class rep is, and she has a lot to do.
sentences.Malik sier at han vil sende mer informas: Malik says he will send her more information.
sentences.Han håper at hun sier ja når hun har les: He hopes she'll say yes when she has read what a class rep is.
